name: Ultrix FR1 (1RU)
source: Ross Ultrix specifications page, Ultrix FR1/FR2 Quick Start Guide (2101DR-002) and Ultrix Installation Guide (2101DR-003)
notes: 1RU hyperconverged router frame. Built-in 16 x 16 HD-BNC (bottom row: OUT 1-16 then IN 1-16) plus 2 AUX SFP ports (SDI, HDMI or 64 ch MADI), 1 I/O/processing card slot above it, max matrix 36x36. ENET 1 primary, ENET 2 backup 1GbE. USB-A for a USB-serial adapter. Four 15V DC PSU inputs numbered 1-4 from the left, fed by external supplies (brick or Ultripower); ships with one supply. Frame weight 4.06 kg. Card I/O (HDX-IO, MODX-IO, IP cards) is not included: add it to the device as extra ports. Check: any GPI ports on your hardware revision.
layoutSource: Ross Ultrix Installation Guide (2101DR-003), rear panel figure

name: Ultrix FR2 (2RU)
source: Ross Ultrix specifications page, Ultrix FR1/FR2 Quick Start Guide (2101DR-002) and Ultrix Installation Guide (2101DR-003)
notes: 2RU hyperconverged router frame. Built-in 16 x 16 HD-BNC (bottom row: OUT 1-16 then IN 1-16) plus 2 AUX SFP ports (SDI, HDMI or 64 ch MADI), 3 I/O/processing card slots above it, max matrix 72x72. ENET 1 primary, ENET 2 backup 1GbE. USB-A for a USB-serial adapter. Four 15V DC PSU inputs numbered 1-4 from the left, fed by external supplies (brick or Ultripower); ships with two supplies. Frame weight 5.44 kg. Card I/O (HDX-IO, MODX-IO, IP cards) is not included: add it to the device as extra ports. Also the host frame for Ultrix Carbonite (up to 2 SDPE switcher blades). Check: any GPI ports on your hardware revision.
layoutSource: Ross Ultrix Installation Guide (2101DR-003), rear panel figure

name: Ultrix FR5 (5RU)
source: Ross Ultrix specifications page; Ultrix Carbonite and Acuity frame guides
notes: 5RU Ultrix frame with 9 I/O/processing slots (one is a FLEX slot), max matrix 160x160, no built-in SDI. Powered from up to 2 external 1RU Ultripower frames (plus redundant). Frame weight 6.35 kg without cards. Host frame for Ultrix Carbonite and Ultrix Acuity (SDPE blades: up to 4; each blade adds GPI DB25, Tally DB25, Editor, 2 AES, LTC). Card I/O is not included: add it to the device as extra ports. Check: exact rear layout and connector types for the reference, serial and Ethernet ports.

name: Ultrix FR12 (12RU)
source: Ross Ultrix specifications page; Ultrix Carbonite and Acuity frame guides
notes: 12RU Ultrix frame with 16 I/O/processing slots, max matrix 288x288, no built-in SDI. Powered from up to 3 external 1RU Ultripower frames (plus redundant). Frame weight 34.47 kg without cards. Host frame for Ultrix Carbonite and Ultrix Acuity (SDPE blades: up to 8; each blade adds GPI DB25, Tally DB25, Editor, 2 AES, LTC). Card I/O is not included: add it to the device as extra ports. Check: exact rear layout and connector types for the reference, serial and Ethernet ports.

name: Ultrix 30RU frame
notes: 30RU Ultrix frame, 32 I/O/processing slots, max matrix 576x576, up to 8 integrated plug-in power modules (2N redundancy), 16.9 in deep, 123 kg without cards. Card I/O not included. Check: part number, rear connectors and power inlet type.

name: Ultripower 1RU power frame
notes: 1RU external power frame for Ultrix FR5/FR12, Ultrix Carbonite and Acuity blades, optional on FR1/FR2 and Carbonite Ultra. Front labelled ports 1-4, OUT, RESTART, ETHERNET, RESET. Several units are grouped and managed with Ultripower Manager. Check: which face the DC outputs are on, mains inlet count, and output count on your unit.

name: NRG 16x16 router (1RU)
source: NRG-FR1 and NRG-FR1-LCP Quick Start Guide (2200DR-401)
notes: 1RU 16x16 12G router, 270 Mb/s to 12G, ASI, MADI. Output 16 doubles as the quad-split multiviewer SDI output; DisplayPort 1.2a multiviewer head. 15V DC on PWR 1, optional redundant supply on PWR 2, no power switch. 31.7 W max. 8.8 cm deep. Control: GVG Native, SW-P-08. Check: USB connector type.

name: NRG 32x34 router (2RU)
source: NRG-FR2 and NRG-FR2-LCP Quick Start Guide (2200DR-402)
notes: 2RU 32x34 12G router (32 BNC in and out plus MV1/MV2 outputs). One quad-split multiviewer head standard, second licensable; DisplayPort 1.2a head output. ETH 1 primary, ETH 2 backup. 15V DC, redundant PWR 2. 56.6 W max. Check: MV1/MV2 connector type (assumed HD-BNC SDI).

name: NRG 16x16 router (1RU) with local panel
source: NRG-FR1 and NRG-FR1-LCP Quick Start Guide (2200DR-401)
notes: 1RU 16x16 12G router, 270 Mb/s to 12G, ASI, MADI. Output 16 doubles as the quad-split multiviewer SDI output; DisplayPort 1.2a multiviewer head. 15V DC on PWR 1, optional redundant supply on PWR 2, no power switch. Front local control panel. 35.2 W max. 8.8 cm deep. Control: GVG Native, SW-P-08. Check: USB connector type.

name: NRG 32x34 router (2RU) with local panel
source: NRG-FR2 and NRG-FR2-LCP Quick Start Guide (2200DR-402)
notes: 2RU 32x34 12G router (32 BNC in and out plus MV1/MV2 outputs). One quad-split multiviewer head standard, second licensable; DisplayPort 1.2a head output. ETH 1 primary, ETH 2 backup. 15V DC, redundant PWR 2. Front local control panel. 64.0 W max. Check: MV1/MV2 connector type (assumed HD-BNC SDI).

name: NRG 64x68 router (3RU)
source: NRG product page and solution brief
notes: 3RU 64x68 12G router, no local panel option, 2.90 kg. Check: part number, how the 68 outputs split between router and MV outputs, and the rear ports (inferred from the FR2).

name: NK-3G164 16x4 router
notes: 1RU 16x4 3G-SDI utility router, 75 ohm BNC, cable-equalised inputs, reclocking outputs. +15V DC from the included universal supply, 16 W; optional redundant NK-RP1/P (1RU) or a second NK-P1. Set up by web browser or DashBoard via NK-IPS. Check: T-Bus and reference connectors on the rear (not listed on the Ross page).

name: NK-3G16 16x16 router
notes: 1RU 16x16 3G-SDI utility router, 75 ohm BNC, cable-equalised inputs, reclocking outputs. +15V DC from the included universal supply, 16 W; optional redundant NK-RP1/P (1RU) or a second NK-P1. Set up by web browser or DashBoard via NK-IPS. Check: T-Bus and reference connectors on the rear (not listed on the Ross page).

name: NK-3G34 34x34 router
notes: 2RU 34x34 3G-SDI utility router, 75 ohm BNC, cable-equalised inputs, reclocking outputs. +15V DC from the included universal supply, 30 W; optional redundant NK-RP1/P (1RU) or a second NK-P1. Set up by web browser or DashBoard via NK-IPS. Check: T-Bus and reference connectors on the rear (not listed on the Ross page).

name: NK-3G64 64x64 router
notes: 3RU 64x64 3G-SDI utility router, 75 ohm BNC, cable-equalised inputs, reclocking outputs. +15V DC from the included universal supply, 60 W; optional redundant NK-RP1/P (1RU) or a second NK-P1. Set up by web browser or DashBoard via NK-IPS. Expandable in groups of 8 in and 8 out. Check: rack height. Check: T-Bus and reference connectors on the rear (not listed on the Ross page).

name: NK-3G72 72x72 router
notes: 3RU 72x72 3G-SDI utility router, 75 ohm BNC, cable-equalised inputs, reclocking outputs. +15V DC from the included universal supply, 60 W; optional redundant NK-RP1/P (1RU) or a second NK-P1. Set up by web browser or DashBoard via NK-IPS. Expandable in groups of 8 in and 8 out, 12 cm deep. Check: T-Bus and reference connectors on the rear (not listed on the Ross page).

name: NK-RP1 redundant power supply
notes: 1RU 100 W +15V redundant supply for NK routers, connects with NK-S12/P or NK-D12/PN cables. Check: number of DC outputs.

name: NK-3G144 144x144 router
notes: 10RU, 320 mm deep, 144x144 3G/HD/SD-SDI router built from 8-port input (NK-I3G) and output (NK-O3G) cards, 18 input and 22 output slots. Slots 15D-18D give duplicate outputs 113D-144D for monitoring. Looping reference, T-Bus on RJ45 (straight CAT5), alarm relay, one PSU included with a second IEC for a redundant load-sharing PSU, under 500 W. No Ethernet on the frame; control via NK-IPS. Check: number of T-Bus RJ45 connectors.

name: NK-IPS network bridge
notes: 1RU, 2.4 cm deep. Gateway from Ethernet (10 Mbps, static or DHCP) to the NK T-Bus, with a buffered 8-port T-Bus hub; web and DashBoard set-up, firmware and alarms. Universal supply included, optional NK-RP1/P or NK-P1 redundant power. Check: T-Bus connector type.

name: NK-VRC virtual routing core
notes: Maps physical sources and destinations of an NK system to virtual ones and ties router levels (for example analog and digital) through external resources. Universal supply included, optional NK-RP1/P (NK-D12/P cable) or NK-P1. Needs DashBoard. Check: rack height (1RU assumed from a site drawing) and rear connectors, not listed on the Ross page.

name: NK-M16 machine control / data router
notes: 1RU 16-port RS-422 machine control (data) router, DB9 female ports, 6.4 cm deep, 9 W. Universal supply included, optional NK-RP1/P or NK-P1 redundant power. Check: T-Bus connectors.

name: NK-M32 machine control / data router
notes: 2RU 32-port RS-422 machine control (data) router, DB9 female ports, 6.4 cm deep, 15 W. Universal supply included, optional NK-RP1/P or NK-P1 redundant power. Check: T-Bus connectors.

name: Carbonite Ultra 1RU switcher frame
notes: 1RU, 254 mm deep, 5.9 kg. 24 HD-BNC inputs (18 at UHD), 12 outputs: 10 assignable plus 2 dedicated MultiViewer (11 at UHD). Up to 3 MEs and 4 MiniMEs, up to 4 MultiViewers. 24 GPI/O and 24 tallies, RS-422 editor port, LTC input, 2 AES outputs. 114 W from the standard external supply or optional Ultripower. Also the frame for Carbonite Mosaic. Optional 1RU Audio Breakout Module (8 analog in, 5 out, AES in/out). Check: GPI/tally, LTC and AES connector types.

name: Carbonite Ultra Solo switcher
notes: 12 in, 6 out, 1 ME, 2 MiniMEs, 1 MultiViewer, UHD capable. Sold as an all-in-one unit or 1RU. Check: rear connectors (only counts are published) and whether outputs include the MultiViewer.

name: Carbonite Ultra 60 3RU switcher frame
source: Ross Ultra 60 / Ultrix Carbonite / Acuity product matrix (2024)
notes: 3RU modular frame, 444.5 mm rear width, 9.07 kg. Shown fully loaded (3 I/O boards: 60 in x 25 out). Base engine is 12 x 4; 2 boards give 36 x 12. Up to 3 MEs, 4 MiniMEs, up to 7 MultiViewers. 24 GPI/O, 24 tallies, 1 serial, LTC in, ref in and loop plus independent ref out. 800 W 12V DC supply, AC 100-240 V. Check: split of the 25 outputs between program and MV, connector types.

name: Carbonite Black frame (x36 family)
notes: Carbonite Black / Black+ / Black+ 12G frame (x36, x36+, x36+12G). 36 BNC inputs, outputs up to 22 (11-22 have format converters on x36+), MultiViewers on outputs 1-2 plus MV3-MV5 on x36+ frames. GPI/O DB37 (34 lines), Tally DB37 (34), RS-422 on RJ45, LAN1/LAN2, AES stereo out, LTC in, PS1/PS2 supplies. 120 W (x36), 180 W (x36+), 206 W (x36+12G); x36+12G inputs are 12G. Check: rack height and exact output count for your frame.

name: Graphite all-in-one production system
notes: 4RU all-in-one system: Carbonite switcher, audio mixer, XPression graphics and clip player. Check: rear I/O is not published on the product page, add the ports from your unit.

name: Tria+ 4-channel production server
notes: 3RU, 65.1 cm deep, slide rails included. 4 bi-directional channels (each 1 SDI in, 1 SDI out on HD-BNC, quad-link 2160p supported), 1 quad viewer BNC out. Ref in, LTC XLR, 8 RS-422 on RJ45 (octal breakout to D9), gigabit Ethernet, 2 DP + 1 HDMI GUI outputs, AES on 2 x D25, dual hot-swap PSUs. Check: 10G Ethernet option.

name: Tria+ 8-channel production server
notes: 3RU, 65.1 cm deep, slide rails included. 8 bi-directional channels (each 1 SDI in, 1 SDI out on HD-BNC, quad-link 2160p supported), 2 quad viewer BNC out. Ref in, LTC XLR, 8 RS-422 on RJ45 (octal breakout to D9), gigabit Ethernet, 2 DP + 1 HDMI GUI outputs, AES on 2 x D25, dual hot-swap PSUs. Check: 10G Ethernet option.

name: Tria+ 12-channel production server
notes: 3RU, 65.1 cm deep, slide rails included. 12 bi-directional channels (each 1 SDI in, 1 SDI out on HD-BNC, quad-link 2160p supported), 3 quad viewer BNC out. Ref in, LTC XLR, 8 RS-422 on RJ45 (octal breakout to D9), gigabit Ethernet, 2 DP + 1 HDMI GUI outputs, AES on 2 x D25, dual hot-swap PSUs. Check: 10G Ethernet option.

name: openGear OGX-FR-CNS 20-slot frame
notes: 2RU openGear oGx frame, 20 front-loading card slots with rear module slots. MFC-OG3-N network/controller card (1000BASE-T, SNMP). REF 1 and REF 2 with loops, PS1 main and PS2 redundant power (100-240 V, IEC C13 cords). Allow 2 in side and 5 in rear clearance. Place cards in the frame's slots.

frame.controller: GFC-8322 in a dedicated slot right of PS1; network card MFC-OG3-N

name: openGear OGX-FR-CN 20-slot frame
notes: 2RU openGear oGx frame, 20 front-loading card slots with rear module slots. MFC-OG3-N network/controller card (1000BASE-T). REF 1 and REF 2 with loops, PS1 main and PS2 redundant power (100-240 V, IEC C13 cords). Allow 2 in side and 5 in rear clearance. Place cards in the frame's slots.

frame.controller: GFC-8322 in a dedicated slot right of PS1; network card MFC-OG3-N

name: openGear OGX-FR-C 20-slot frame
notes: 2RU openGear oGx frame, 20 front-loading card slots with rear module slots. MFC-8322-S network/controller card (100BASE-TX). REF 1 and REF 2 with loops, PS1 main and PS2 redundant power (100-240 V, IEC C13 cords). Allow 2 in side and 5 in rear clearance. Place cards in the frame's slots.

frame.controller: GFC-8322 in a dedicated slot right of PS1; network card MFC-OG3-N

name: openGear OG3-FR 20-slot frame (legacy)
notes: Previous-generation 2RU, 20-slot openGear frame. Place cards in the frame's slots. Check: rear layout (assumed same as OGX-FR).

frame.controller: GFC-8322 in a dedicated slot right of PS1; network card MFC-OG3-N

name: openGear DFR-8321 20-slot frame (legacy)
notes: First-generation 2RU, 20-slot openGear frame (DFR-8321-BN with network card, -C with cooling door); takes DFR-8321 generation rear modules. Superseded by OG3-FR and OGX-FR. Place cards in the frame's slots. Check: rear layout (assumed same as OGX-FR) and the Ethernet option fitted.

frame.controller: GFC-8322 in a dedicated slot right of PS1; network card MFC-OG3-N

name: Ultritouch 2RU touchscreen panel
notes: 2RU touchscreen control panel (DashBoard/Ultrix control), 2.5 in deep, Gorilla Glass. Redundant Ethernet, HDMI, USB, external power supply with optional redundant supply. Check: connector counts (page lists features, not counts).

name: Ultritouch 4RU touchscreen panel
notes: 4RU touchscreen control panel (DashBoard/Ultrix control), 2.5 in deep, Gorilla Glass. Redundant Ethernet, HDMI, USB, external power supply with optional redundant supply. VESA mount. Check: connector counts (page lists features, not counts).
